limitations: All prior examples/results were seen: regression, not independent holdout.
Human-reviewed phase invalidity is explicitly separated from automatic selector/model improvement.
Nineteen accepted windows have reviewed types, fifty-three remain generic.
Forehand slice and every return variant still lack reliable real source-bound validation.
Complete serve has separate manual-window metric evidence, but no accepted automatic serve profile.
No real measured projected hip-thorax sequence; do not infer chronology from static posture.
Existing four GPU runs repeat prior sources and are not new independent subjects.
Frozen-pose fallback cannot create native poses for newly selected people; missing native frames stay missing.
